title: Language Representation
description: How machines convert raw text into numbers they can reason about. Every LLM starts here — tokenisation, embeddings, and the geometry of meaning.

days.title: How an LLM Actually Learns
days.description: Understand what training really means and why 'GPT reads billions of books' is only half the story.

days.title: From Text to Numbers
days.description: Learn why computers cannot understand words directly, how tokenization works, and why a neural network starts as an empty brain with random parameters.

days.title: Learning from Mistakes
days.description: Discover how GPT learns through prediction, loss calculation, backpropagation, and parameter updates.

days.title: Inside the GPT Architecture
days.description: Explore the internal structure of GPT and understand where knowledge is stored after training.

days.title: Inside One Training Iteration
days.description: Follow a single input as it flows through the neural network and understand what every layer actually does during a forward pass.

days.title: From Scores to Predictions
days.description: Learn how GPT converts raw prediction scores into probabilities and finally chooses the next token.

days.title: Measuring Mistakes with Cross Entropy Loss
days.description: Learn how GPT measures the quality of its predictions and why Cross Entropy Loss became the standard loss function for language models.

days.title: Learning Through Backpropagation
days.description: Discover how GPT traces mistakes backward through the network to determine exactly which parameters should change.

days.title: Gradient Descent & Optimization
days.description: Learn how GPT updates its parameters after backpropagation and why optimization algorithms like Gradient Descent and Adam are essential for learning.

days.title: One Complete GPT Training Walkthrough
days.description: Bring together everything you've learned in Module 1 by following one complete GPT training iteration from raw text to updated parameters.

days.title: Engineering Insights: Behind LLM Training
days.description: Quick engineering insights that explain how Large Language Models are actually trained behind the scenes.

title: Transformer Architecture
description: The architecture that changed everything. Built from first principles: attention, layers, and why this design works so well for language.

days.title: Why Token IDs Are Not Enough
days.description: Understand why GPT converts Token IDs into embedding vectors before any Transformer computation begins.

days.title: The Embedding Matrix
days.description: Discover where embedding vectors come from, why they start random, and how GPT learns meaningful representations.

days.title: How Embeddings Learn Meaning
days.description: Discover how random embedding vectors gradually become meaningful through training and why similar words end up close together.

days.title: Static vs Contextual Embeddings
days.description: Learn why the same word can have different meanings depending on context and how Transformers solve this limitation.

days.title: Why Word Order Matters
days.description: Discover why Transformers cannot understand sequence by themselves and why positional information is essential.

days.title: Learned Positional Embeddings
days.description: Understand how GPT learns the position of every token by assigning a trainable vector to each position.

days.title: Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
days.description: Learn how the original Transformer paper represented token positions using sine and cosine waves instead of learnable vectors.

days.title: The Final Input Representation
days.description: Understand how token embeddings and positional information are combined to create the final representation that enters the first Transformer block.

days.title: Why Self-Attention Was Invented
days.description: Discover why embeddings alone cannot understand context and why researchers invented the Self-Attention mechanism.

days.title: Query, Key and Value Intuition
days.description: Build an intuitive understanding of why every token is transformed into Query, Key, and Value vectors before Self-Attention begins.

days.title: From Embeddings to Query, Key and Value
days.description: Learn how GPT transforms a single embedding into Query, Key, and Value vectors using three learnable weight matrices.

days.title: Dot Product Attention & Attention Scores
days.description: Learn how GPT measures the relevance between tokens using the Dot Product and builds the Attention Score Matrix.

days.title: Why Do We Divide by √d?
days.description: Understand why Transformers scale the Attention Scores before applying Softmax and why √d keeps training numerically stable.

days.title: Softmax: From Scores to Attention Weights
days.description: Learn how Softmax converts scaled Attention Scores into probability distributions, creating the Attention Weight Matrix used by Self-Attention.

days.title: Attention Weights × Value Matrix
days.description: Learn how GPT uses the Attention Weight Matrix to combine information from the Value vectors and create contextual representations.

days.title: One Complete Self-Attention Walkthrough
days.description: Follow one complete Self-Attention computation from input embeddings to contextual representations.

days.title: Why One Attention Head Isn't Enough
days.description: Understand why Transformers use multiple attention heads instead of relying on a single Self-Attention mechanism.

days.title: Inside Multi-Head Attention
days.description: Explore the internal architecture of Multi-Head Attention, understand how embeddings are divided across multiple heads, and learn why this design remains computationally efficient.

days.title: Bringing All Attention Heads Together
days.description: Learn how GPT combines the outputs of multiple attention heads using concatenation and the output projection matrix.

days.title: Why Self-Attention Alone Isn't Enough
days.description: Learn why Self-Attention is only the communication layer of a Transformer and why another neural network is required.

days.title: Inside the Feed Forward Network
days.description: Open the Feed Forward Network and understand its architecture, dimensions, and why every token passes through the same neural network independently.

days.title: Inside the Feed Forward Network (Part 2)
days.description: Follow the complete transformation of a token inside the Feed Forward Network, from expansion to activation to compression.

days.title: Opening the Feed Forward Network
days.description: Open the Feed Forward Network and explore what actually happens inside its Linear layers.

days.title: Why Residual (Skip) Connections Exist
days.description: Understand why researchers invented residual connections and how they made very deep Transformers trainable.

days.title: Residual Connections — What They Actually Skip
days.description: Understand the biggest misconception about skip connections and how residual connections create an identity pathway.

days.title: Layer Normalization — Stabilizing Every Transformer Layer
days.description: Understand why Transformer activations become unstable, how Layer Normalization stabilizes them, why learnable γ and β are needed, and why modern GPT-style models use Pre-LayerNorm.

days.title: Causal Masking — How GPT Prevents Itself From Cheating
days.description: Understand how causal masking prevents GPT from looking at future tokens during autoregressive training and connects training to generation.

days.title: Why One Transformer Block Isn't Enough
days.description: Understand why GPT stacks many Transformer blocks, how hidden representations evolve layer by layer, and why deeper models build progressively richer representations.

title: LLM Internals
description: Inside the large language model: how training works, what the model is actually doing during inference, and why it behaves the way it does.

days.title: How LLMs Are Trained
days.description: Pre-training, next-token prediction, and the scale that makes it work.

days.title: Inference & Token Generation
days.description: What actually happens when an LLM generates text, one token at a time.

days.title: Temperature & Sampling
days.description: Why the same prompt can produce different outputs, and how to control it.

days.title: Fine-Tuning & RLHF
days.description: How base models are shaped into assistants through instruction tuning and human feedback.

days.title: System Prompts & Prompt Engineering
days.description: How instructions shape LLM behaviour, and what prompt engineering actually is.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: How to give LLMs access to external knowledge without retraining them. The architecture behind most production AI applications.

days.title: Why LLMs Hallucinate
days.description: Understanding the root cause of hallucinations and why RAG is the most practical solution.

days.title: Vector Databases
days.description: How to store and efficiently search millions of embeddings.

days.title: The RAG Pipeline
days.description: The full retrieval-augmented generation flow: chunking, embedding, retrieval, and generation.

days.title: Chunking Strategies
days.description: How you split documents determines retrieval quality. The decisions that most tutorials skip.

days.title: Reranking & Advanced Retrieval
days.description: Why naive vector search is often not enough, and how rerankers close the gap.

title: Agentic AI
description: Moving from a model that answers questions to a system that takes actions. Tools, planning, memory, and the architecture of AI agents.

days.title: What is an AI Agent?
days.description: The difference between an LLM and an agent — and why the gap matters.

days.title: Tool Use & Function Calling
days.description: How agents use tools, and how LLMs are trained to call external functions.

days.title: Memory Systems
days.description: Short-term, long-term, and episodic memory — how agents remember across interactions.

days.title: Planning & ReAct
days.description: How agents reason and act in loops, and the ReAct pattern that makes it reliable.

days.title: Multi-Agent Systems
days.description: When one agent is not enough — orchestrators, workers, and agent-to-agent communication.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: The classical ML models that still underpin much of production AI — and the concepts that make deep learning intelligible.

days.title: What is Learning?
days.description: Formalising the concept of a model learning from data.

days.title: Loss Functions
days.description: How we measure how wrong a model is — and why the choice of loss matters.

days.title: Gradient Descent
days.description: The optimisation algorithm at the heart of every ML model, from linear regression to GPT.

days.title: Overfitting & Regularisation
days.description: The most important concept in practical machine learning — and how to fight it.

title: Deep Learning
description: From a single artificial neuron to the networks that power modern AI — built from scratch, understood from the inside.

days.title: The Perceptron
days.description: The atom of neural computation — one neuron, one decision boundary.

days.title: Backpropagation
days.description: How neural networks learn — the chain rule applied to computational graphs.

days.title: Activation Functions
days.description: Why non-linearity is essential, and what ReLU, sigmoid, and GELU actually do.
